claims: Several school districts in the DC, Maryland, and Virginia area are reporting closures, delays, or early dismissals for Tuesday, March 17, 2026, due to weather conditions.
Prince William County Public Schools is operating on a Code Orange (remote learning) on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Fairfax County Public Schools are dismissing early on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Several schools in Maryland are closing early or have delays on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Prince William County Public Schools has a remote learning day on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Buildings of Prince William County Public Schools are closed on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Fairfax County Public Schools early dismissal occurs at various times based on program on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
Schools in Grant, Hardy, Highland Counties of West Virginia are delayed 2-3 hours on Tuesday, March 17, 2026.
